description: Dear Friends and Neighbors, This weekend, as we come together with family and friends to honor and remember the men and women who have lost their lives while serving in the United States Armed Forces, we also pay tribute to the tremendous sacrifice they made for all of our benefit. Honor and Remember. Wishing you a safe Memorial Day weekend! Best,
